blocks.text: Venture Academy’s innovative therapy approach involves adventure-based learning, which is the practice of using outdoor activities to encourage personal growth and development. This includes activities such as rock climbing, canoeing, and ropes courses. Adventure-based learning provides a unique opportunity for teens to step out of their comfort zones and develop new skills while building confidence and resilience. These activities take place in a safe and controlled environment, allowing students to develop a sense of trust, teamwork, and responsibility. Adventure-based learning is a central part of Venture Academy’s program, as it provides a fun and engaging way to help students overcome challenges and develop a positive mindset.

blocks.text: At Venture Academy, we take a holistic approach to therapy, which means we address all aspects of a student’s life, including their physical, emotional, and spiritual health. We believe that each of these areas is interconnected and essential to a teen’s overall well-being. Our holistic approach involves a wide range of therapies, from talk therapy to expressive therapies, nutrition, and exercise. We encourage healthy habits and lifestyle changes that can lead to long-term improvements in students’ physical and mental health. Our team of professionals takes a collaborative approach, working together to create personalized plans that are tailored to each student’s needs.

The center provides comprehensive counseling, substance use treatment, and educational support services to teens between the ages of 13-18. centre.about_html:
Adventure-based Learning

Venture Academy’s innovative therapy approach involves adventure-based learning, which is the practice of using outdoor activities to encourage personal growth and development. This includes activities such as rock climbing, canoeing, and ropes courses. Adventure-based learning provides a unique opportunity for teens to step out of their comfort zones and develop new skills while building confidence and resilience. These activities take place in a safe and controlled environment, allowing students to develop a sense of trust, teamwork, and responsibility. Adventure-based learning is a central part of Venture Academy’s program, as it provides a fun and engaging way to help students overcome challenges and develop a positive mindset.

Holistic Approach

At Venture Academy, we take a holistic approach to therapy, which means we address all aspects of a student’s life, including their physical, emotional, and spiritual health. We believe that each of these areas is interconnected and essential to a teen’s overall well-being. Our holistic approach involves a wide range of therapies, from talk therapy to expressive therapies, nutrition, and exercise. We encourage healthy habits and lifestyle changes that can lead to long-term improvements in students’ physical and mental health. Our team of professionals takes a collaborative approach, working together to create personalized plans that are tailored to each student’s needs.

Family Support

We believe that family involvement is crucial to a student’s success, which is why we provide full family support and therapy. Our program involves regular family therapy sessions, where we work to address and resolve any underlying issues that may be affecting the student’s behavior. We also provide ongoing training and support for the parents and family members, equipping them with the tools and resources they need to support their teen’s recovery. Our team works closely with the family throughout the treatment process, providing regular updates on the student’s progress and helping to ensure a smooth transition home.

Mental Health Support

At Venture Academy, we understand how challenging it can be for teens struggling with mental health issues. Therefore, we offer a wide range of mental health support to help students address these issues. Our program includes individual, group, and family therapy, as well as medication management, if necessary. Therapy is provided by licensed and experienced professionals who specialize in adolescent mental health. We use evidence-based practices and customized treatment plans to assist each student in achieving their goals and maintaining stable mental health.





Venture Academy - Center Overview

Venture Academy’s Drug and Alcohol Treatment Program is a leading rehab center designed to help male and female teens overcome various issues related to alcohol or substance abuse. The center provides comprehensive counseling, substance use treatment, and educational support services to teens between the ages of 13-18. Venture Academy specializes in helping troubled teens with a history of substance abuse and focuses on healing the underlying conditions that have led to harmful behaviors.

Venture Academy’s Drug and Alcohol Treatment Program offers a variety of specialized services to help troubled teens overcome addiction. These services include 12 step programs, residential drug rehab, intensive outpatient programs, assessments, holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga, meditation, individual and family therapy, nutritional counseling, art, and nature therapy. The center aims to provide a supportive environment where troubled teens can find healing, learn positive strategies, and develop essential life skills that can help them lead a productive and successful life. Through these specialized programs and services, Venture Academy’s Drug and Alcohol Treatment Program strives to help teens eliminate destructive behaviors, build healthy relationships and lead a fulfilling life free of substance abuse.

Frequently Asked Questions About Venture Academy

How long is the program?

The program length varies depending on each student’s needs, but it typically ranges from 6-12 months.

What is the staff-to-student ratio at Venture Academy?

Our staff-to-student ratio is 1:3, which means each student receives personalized attention and support.

What is adventure-based learning?

Adventure-based learning is the practice of using outdoor activities to encourage personal growth and development.

Do you offer academic support?

Yes, Venture Academy provides customized academic support and stimulating engagement to help students regain confidence and get back on track.

Are parents involved in therapy sessions?

Yes, parents are involved in therapy sessions to address and resolve any underlying issues that may be affecting the student’s behavior.

Do you offer mental health support?

Yes, Venture Academy offers a wide range of mental health support, including individual, group, and family therapy, as well as medication management, if necessary.

Is Venture Academy a safe environment?

Yes, Venture Academy prioritizes safety and creates a controlled environment where students can feel secure and supported.

raw_html:
Adventure-based Learning

Venture Academy’s innovative therapy approach involves adventure-based learning, which is the practice of using outdoor activities to encourage personal growth and development. This includes activities such as rock climbing, canoeing, and ropes courses. Adventure-based learning provides a unique opportunity for teens to step out of their comfort zones and develop new skills while building confidence and resilience. These activities take place in a safe and controlled environment, allowing students to develop a sense of trust, teamwork, and responsibility. Adventure-based learning is a central part of Venture Academy’s program, as it provides a fun and engaging way to help students overcome challenges and develop a positive mindset.

Holistic Approach

At Venture Academy, we take a holistic approach to therapy, which means we address all aspects of a student’s life, including their physical, emotional, and spiritual health. We believe that each of these areas is interconnected and essential to a teen’s overall well-being. Our holistic approach involves a wide range of therapies, from talk therapy to expressive therapies, nutrition, and exercise. We encourage healthy habits and lifestyle changes that can lead to long-term improvements in students’ physical and mental health. Our team of professionals takes a collaborative approach, working together to create personalized plans that are tailored to each student’s needs.

Family Support

We believe that family involvement is crucial to a student’s success, which is why we provide full family support and therapy. Our program involves regular family therapy sessions, where we work to address and resolve any underlying issues that may be affecting the student’s behavior. We also provide ongoing training and support for the parents and family members, equipping them with the tools and resources they need to support their teen’s recovery. Our team works closely with the family throughout the treatment process, providing regular updates on the student’s progress and helping to ensure a smooth transition home.

Mental Health Support

At Venture Academy, we understand how challenging it can be for teens struggling with mental health issues. Therefore, we offer a wide range of mental health support to help students address these issues. Our program includes individual, group, and family therapy, as well as medication management, if necessary. Therapy is provided by licensed and experienced professionals who specialize in adolescent mental health. We use evidence-based practices and customized treatment plans to assist each student in achieving their goals and maintaining stable mental health.

The center aims to provide a supportive environment where troubled teens can find healing, learn positive strategies, and develop essential life skills that can help them lead a productive and successful life. Through these specialized programs and services, Venture Academy’s Drug and Alcohol Treatment Program strives to help teens eliminate destructive behaviors, build healthy relationships and lead a fulfilling life free of substance abuse.
